oracleProfile.throughputPolicy: Performance measurements may use compiled native candidates or separately identified runtime flags. Qualification compares candidate traces against this pinned source profile; measurements alone do not establish equivalence.
oracleProfile.scope: Reproducible reference implementation profile, not a claim that ECMAScript specifies NaN sign/payload or that all engine versions produce identical bits.

scope: Pinned jitless V8 observation of array Number storage, with fresh realms per operation/input/history and exact DataView input/output bits. Covers payload/sign/signaling NaNs, signed zero, literals, Smi/double/object initializers, holes, writes, push, slice, spread, concat and repeated-call history. Labels describe source initializers, not verified internal V8 elements kinds. This is source-engine evidence only; no native runtime changes or battle qualification.
